title: Former Texas RB Jonathan Brooks reportedly ‘fully healthy’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Former Texas RB Jonathan Brooks reportedly ‘fully healthy’
sources.description: Texas running back Jonathan Brooks is heading into his third season in the NFL, but due to setbacks in both his rookie and second seasons in the league, the former Longhorns standout has yet to participate in the Carolina Panthers’ training camp.
